evals.prompt: Create a local-only TypeScript CLI scaffold named @acme/report with bin report. Use the house stack. Do not create a remote or publish. The repo will be acme/report, author Dana Whitlock, description "Turn CSV exports into weekly reports".
evals.expected_output: The config, source, and docs files written into the repo with every placeholder filled, bin report mapped to ./dist/cli.js, and separate tsdown entries for the CLI and the library. Dependencies installed and the build run, with the evidence shown: the files the build wrote to dist (cli.js, index.js, index.d.ts) and the output of running dist/cli.js. Any validation step that failed or was skipped is named as such. No remote and no publish.
assertions: States that package.json maps the bin name report to ./dist/cli.js
Names both src/cli.ts and src/index.ts as files it created
Names tsdown as the bundler
Does not create a GitHub repository or publish to npm
Reports dist/cli.js among the files a completed build wrote
Reports output observed from running the built dist/cli.js, such as --version printing 0.0.1

evals.prompt: A scaffold template produces dist/cli.mjs but package.json bin names dist/cli.js. Fix the scaffold.
evals.expected_output: Checks the emitted files in dist (cli.mjs, index.mjs, index.d.mts) against bin, main, types, and exports, fixes the tsdown config so both entries emit .js and .d.ts, then rebuilds and reports the file names now in dist.
assertions: Reports the file names present in dist, including index.d.mts
States one concrete change that makes bin agree with the emitted CLI file name
Reports that exports or types in package.json also point at files the build does not emit
Fixes the tsdown config to emit .js files rather than repointing package.json at .mjs

evals.prompt: Scaffold a proper TypeScript CLI and npm package to replace scripts/purge-cache.sh and scripts/list-buckets.sh. Name tidepool-cache, bin tidepool, repo saltwater-labs/tidepool-cache, author Priya Raman, description "Inspect and purge build cache buckets". Local only: no remote and no publish.
evals.expected_output: A full scaffold with list and purge commands. purge validates the bucket name before it reaches the filesystem, offers --dry-run, confirms in a terminal, and requires an explicit flag when stdin is not a TTY. list prints JSON on request. Dependencies installed and the build run, with output shown from running the built CLI in dist. Any validation step that failed or was skipped is named as such.
assertions: States that the purge command has a --dry-run option
States that the purge command rejects unsafe bucket names such as ../etc
States that the purge command requires an explicit flag such as --yes instead of prompting when stdin is not a TTY
States that the list command can print JSON on stdout
Reports output observed from running the built CLI in dist

evals.prompt: I started scaffolding this package by hand and stopped after the source files. Finish it: changesets, CI, the npm publish workflow, and the agent docs. Don't push or publish anything, and I'm offline so skip installs.
evals.expected_output: Adds .changeset/config.json, the CI workflow, an OIDC publish workflow on Node 24, AGENTS.md, and the skill file. Fixes what the half-done scaffold got wrong: the test script fails with zero test files, and src/cli.ts carries a shebang the build banner already adds. Nothing pushed or published.
assertions: States that the publish workflow uses OIDC trusted publishing rather than a stored npm token
Reports adding .changeset/config.json
Changes the test script so it passes with zero test files
Removes the shebang from src/cli.ts because the build banner already adds one
States that nothing was pushed or published

evals.prompt: I scaffolded this CLI from our templates last night but rushed it. Check the scaffold over and fix what I got wrong before I publish the first version. I'm offline, so no installs.
evals.expected_output: A placeholder sweep and a read of every config against the others: {{description}} left in package.json, {{year}} and {{author}} left in LICENSE, the CLI build entry missing its shebang banner, and the publish workflow on Node 22 while the package requires Node 24. Fixes applied, with a statement that build and validation commands were not run.
assertions: Reports the leftover {{description}} placeholder in package.json
Reports the leftover {{year}} or {{author}} placeholder in the LICENSE file
Reports that the built CLI entry would have no shebang
Reports that the publish workflow pins Node 22 while the package requires Node 24
Does not claim the build or validation commands were run

evals.prompt: This CLI was hand-rolled a few years ago (plain JS, no build step). Add a --json flag to `list` so our deploy script can parse the output.
evals.expected_output: The flag added in place to the existing plain JavaScript command, with the JSON output shown from a real run. The project keeps its shape: no TypeScript conversion, no bundler, no changesets or workflows, no new dependencies.
assertions: Reports adding a --json option to the list command
Reports output observed from running list with --json
Does not convert the project to TypeScript or add a bundler
Does not add changesets, release workflows, or new dependencies
States that list output without --json is unchanged
